items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I tell you a boy knows them all, that Tony Fuggera.

ctx.x: Well, it's hard to find a drummer player that knows them now, though. There aren't too many of them, you know. The good ones are working steady. Yeah.

ctx.x: I tell you a boy knows them all, that Tony Fuggera. Oh, yeah. You can't mention any of them that he don't know. That son was going to play any kind of tune, German tunes. He's a guy.
He's a guy. He's a guy. Was it you who was telling me about going to a German dance or something?

At the Dutchess House. He was playing out there. And the Germans come to him and ask him, do you know them German numbers? He said, sure. He said, play. So he started playing them German. And then the German was dancing around. Going nuts. They were buying him more beer than he could consume.
